criteria.description: Playable 3D greenhouse with the declared initial state
Left/right orbit provides a usable spatial view
World picking matches the visible plot after view changes
Blocked and occupied placement are rejected without charge
Purchases and harvests conserve the specified resources
Water-gated real-time growth rejects early harvest
Harvest is single-use and restores an empty reusable pot
Two valid harvests end the round and freeze operations
Restart clears pots, timers, resources and completion
Plot selection, rock/occupancy, the four plant stages, coins and harvest target are distinguishable across camera angles.
Camera/select/buy/seed/water/harvest/restart actions, prices and the two-harvest goal are visible and match tested behavior.
Valid/rejected placement, insufficient funds, watering/growth/readiness, harvest and completion have clear visible state cues.
Pastel miniature-greenhouse style is coherent across plants, pots, setting and UI; lighting/depth do not obscure selection; essential UI fits both viewports.
Observed delivery duration gated by demonstrated main-loop gameplay

limitations: Proposed engine-agnostic browser method; no maintainer acceptance or calibrated live-game judge is claimed.
Data-only protocol, not an executable Harbor task, creator adapter or automated recorder.
Evidence structure/arithmetic does not establish observation truth or authentic provenance.
Visible 3D behavior is assessed, not source-level engine implementation, exact physics or measured FPS.
Remote URLs can change; model labels and sampled delivery times are observations, not backend attestations.
Non-blind evaluation, platform defaults, missing data and all interventions must be disclosed.
Costs are reported separately; 60/10/30 totals are not historical Tetris scores or proof of equal task difficulty.
